detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Heresy Supreme revolves around a combat system that is punishing yet rewarding

Every choice must be weighed; react in time or face a violent end. And when weapons are not enough, turn to dozens of items to curse, confuse, and drive your enemies into despair.

The Dying Lands are a place where salvation is always temporary and constantly at risk

Gather a party of wretched antiheroes and try to stall the Apocalypse before they betray you and strip you of what little you have. You can’t win. You can only survive.

A perpetually shifting adventure

Built from a large pool of handcrafted situations and quests, constantly rearranged by a semi-procedural system. Enemies, drops, and stats are randomized. Expect no patterns. Expect no mercy.

Features

  • Mesmerizing art-punk graphic style

  • A wretched world doomed by an unavoidable apocalypse

  • A brutal, haunting doom metal soundtrack

  • Multiple classes, each radically different in strategy, strengths, and approach

  • ARPG elements. Light on mechanics, heavy on everything else
